connector.name: Postals MCP
connector.registryDescription: Send physical handwritten postcards from any AI agent. Real pen & ink, USPS, $4.99/card.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package postals-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the coopergwrenn account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: POSTALS_API_KEY
env.description: Your Handwrytten API key (v1.0) or Postals API key (v1.1+).

env.name: POSTALS_SENDER_NAME
env.description: Default sender full name for return address.

env.name: POSTALS_DEFAULT_CARD_IMAGE
env.description: Default card front image URL (HTTPS, PNG or JPEG, landscape 7x5 preferred).

env.name: POSTALS_HANDWRITING_STYLE
env.description: Default handwriting font. Default: Joyful Jennifer.

env.name: POSTALS_DAILY_LIMIT
env.description: Max cards per day (safety net). Default: 50.

env.name: POSTALS_TEST_MODE
env.description: Set to 'true' for test mode (validates inputs, no cards actually sent).

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
env.description: Optional. Enables AI message generation via Cloudflare Workers AI.

env.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
env.description: Optional. Required together with CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID for AI message generation.
